$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/portal-sales.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). W2b schema wave 21/22 (B-W2b-157). Portal sessions run as factory_partner_runtime behind their party's wall (scopedBy party): a customer keeps its own order request drafts (the request, its lines and their sizes: insert, update, delete), sends and withdraws them, asks for a change or a cancel of its own orders and withdraws the ask, and reads its own payment intents; never the office person who decided or answered (hiddenColumns). The office (factory_runtime; the tenant's system context of the API, the worker and the provider's webhook) numbers and sends a draft for the portal (the partner role has no numbering grant), decides requests and answers change requests through apps/factory-api with command(), and makes and moves payment intents. Each partner and office write is held to its columns and moves by the …_portal_sales_w2b_guards triggers. Nothing is deleted but a draft (the customer's own; OD s.1: or one an office person started). No floor grant: none of this is floor work. No cost or margin column: the price a customer was shown is the price grain. B-CP-005 (customer page plan, schema wave "customer page 1/1"): the draft grows step by step — lines of three kinds, the customer's own price per line (brandUnitPrice, the price grain), the parts it sends later, who saved it last — and the people of a by-person line (PortalOrderRequestPerson: the customer writes and removes them while the request is a DRAFT, the office reads them; the floor never); the …_customer_page_guards triggers hold the new columns and rows. OD s.1 (order start plan, schema wave "order start 1/1"; Owner's yes 1a + 2a): the draft is ONE draft order of both doors — the office (orders.manage over the company and the customer, checked by the API) starts a customer's draft (insert), fills it (its lines, their sizes, the people of a by-person line: insert, update, delete), discards a draft an office person started (delete, a DRAFT only), sends it for the customer at its Confirm and names the style drafts it made for it (styleIds, office only: hidden from the partner role); a draft's subject and a line's sizing and open choices (choices, names only) are written by both while it is a DRAFT and read by both (addendum R1-R3: nothing is required to start or to Send). The …_order_start_guards triggers hold the new moves. owb-b1 (order workflow build, schema wave "order workflow 1/1"): both doors write the order's picture of a DRAFT or SENT request and take a line out softly (removedAt) and put it back; a SENT request may be taken back to DRAFT keeping its number; the customer's buyer tells us it paid (PaymentNotice), the office answers. The …_order_workflow_guards triggers hold the new moves. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

PortalOrderRequest.about: A customer starts a draft (insert), edits it (update), discards it (delete, a DRAFT only), sends it (DRAFT to SENT with its number, in the API's system context or its own session) and withdraws a sent one; it reads its own requests, never who in the office decided nor the style drafts the office made for it. OD s.1: the office starts and edits a customer's draft too (insert, update), discards one an office person started (delete, a DRAFT only; the API checks who), names the style drafts it made for a DRAFT or SENT request (styleIds, only added); both doors write its subject while it is a DRAFT, sends a draft with the number it allocated (for the portal, or for the customer at its Confirm), and decides a SENT request: ACCEPTED naming the order or quote it made, or REFUSED in words. The guard keeps a decided request frozen.

PortalOrderRequestLine.about: The customer and the office (OD s.1) write and remove a draft's lines (style, colourway, the price shown, the past order line a reorder copied, its kind and words, its sizing, its open choices: names only) while the request is a DRAFT (the guard); the office reads them to make the order or quote.

PortalOrderRequestSize.about: The customer and the office (OD s.1) write and remove the pieces per size of a draft's lines while the request is a DRAFT (the guard); the office reads them.

PortalOrderRequestPerson.about: B-CP-005: the customer writes and removes the people of a by-person line of its draft (a name, maybe a number, and a size, a measurement sheet of the draft or 'sending later') while the request is a DRAFT (the guard); they go with their line or the discarded draft. OD s.1: the office writes and removes them too (orders.manage over the customer, checked by the API), and reads them (a draft from its first save, then the request it decides). Personal data of the person named (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)); the floor reads none of it.

OrderChangeRequest.about: A customer asks for a change or a cancel of its own CONFIRMED, IN_PRODUCTION or READY order (insert, OPEN) and withdraws an OPEN ask (the only partner update the guard lets through); it reads its own requests and the office's answer, never who answered. The office answers: ACCEPTED (naming the amendment it made) or REFUSED in words. The cut-off rules are checked by the API (SalesSettings has no party key, so the partner role cannot read them). B-PR-23 (production plan, schema wave 4/5): the production asks (RUSH, HOLD, RESUME, SPLIT_SHIPMENT, SAMPLE_ROUND; a PARTLY_SHIPPED order only CANCEL, RUSH, HOLD, RESUME), the impact shown at Send (never an amount), the batch of a bulk ask, and the office's counter-offer (COUNTERED: its COUNTER_OFFER approval, date, fee as a price, words), which the customer reads, never who countered (counteredById hidden); the customer may also withdraw a COUNTERED ask. B-SA-005 (sales page plan, schema wave "sales page 1/1"; lead picks R3, P21): a DESIGN ask with its words, its lines and up to 10 of the order's files (fileIds: AVAILABLE files of the order or its lines shared with its own customer, written with the ask, never changed) and the ask's own message in the order's conversation (askMessageId: its INBOUND message shared with it on the order's thread, set with the ask or once while it waits, never changed); the customer inserts, reads and names both; the office reads them, and the product change requests and work-order changes an accepted request led to are the office's (changes.json, order-apply.json).

OrderChangeRequestLine.about: The customer writes the cells it asks for with its OPEN request (a line of the request's order, the pieces before and asked; B-PR-23: a change's new colourway of the line's style); nobody changes or removes one. The office reads them to answer.

PaymentIntent.about: The API makes an intent in the tenant's system context before it calls the payment provider (for a portal user or a PAYMENT or DEPOSIT_INFO link), and the provider's signed webhook moves it (WAITING, SUCCEEDED with the Payment the payments command recorded, FAILED, CANCELLED); never deleted. A customer reads its own intents (status, amount, the provider's reference for the receipt), never the provider account it ran on nor who started it.

PaymentNotice.about: owb-b1: the customer's buyer tells us it paid for one of its orders (insert, OPEN only: the guard; portal.payments.notify), with the amount (the price grain), the day, how, a note and a proof; it reads its own notices and the office's answer, never who answered. The office reads every notice of the tenant (the API scopes it by company and customer) and answers each once: RECORDED (after it recorded the payment with its own command) or DISMISSED. Nobody deletes a notice; the floor reads none.
